name: AussieLinx
summary: Sydney micro-telco brand of the Aussie Dial Pty Ltd group (ABN 26 105 926 449, Blakehurst NSW; stable incl. AussieISP and AussiePCShop); AussieISP folded into it Jul 2014 (aussieisp.com 302). Group sites later went offline; closure date unverified.

events.details: aussielinx.com.au carrying the Aussie Dial group brands by late 2014 (Aussie Dial launched as newest addition Dec 2014).
Group sites went offline later; exact closure unverified (no death event recorded).
